artifacts.summary: 9-phase plan closing five defects behind one shared archive-lookup library: cycle-plan forced-phase eligibility exemption, classifier archive read, skill_validate_input terminal bypass + archive fallback, preflight monotonic-max clamp with archive-absent write skip, and archived-task-directory path resolution; plus fixtures for both suites and docs.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's task-management system, /todo does not merely rewrite state -- it MOVES the task directory from specs/{NNN}_{slug}/ to specs/archive/{NNN}_{slug}/ (skill-todo/SKILL.md Stage 10). Every code path that derives a task directory as the hardcoded string specs/{NNN}_{project_name} (skill-base.sh's skill_validate_input, and roughly five sites in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh: loop-guard seed, aux dispatch, exhausted loop guard, hard-mode H1 plan/handoff read, and the dispatch-row task_dir pair) therefore resolves to a NON-EXISTENT path for an archived task, and silently creates a fresh empty sibling directory rather than failing. Any feature that makes archived tasks reachable (forced /orchestrate phases, recovery, re-dispatch) must route task-directory derivation through a single archive-aware resolver that prefers specs/{NNN}_{slug} and falls back to specs/archive/{NNN}_{slug}, or the work will be scattered across two directories. This is distinct from, and additional to, the state.json-vs-archive/state.json lookup gap: fixing the state lookup alone leaves the directory gap open.
